cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Congratulate Through Your Teeth
cards.instruction: Perform warm praise while allowing competitive resentment to intensify beneath every compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Congratulations on the prize. Such a lovely year for forgiving judges.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are you saying I didn't deserve it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I'm saying they saw past things I couldn't.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That isn't much of a compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then admire how hard I'm working to make it one.

mechanism: Copy an awards gesture without understanding it, then turn the correction into increasingly resentful praise of a rival winner.
confusable: Not ordinary sarcastic praise: B must expose the copied gesture's real purpose and A must borrow that purpose for the next compliment.
comparison: Award competitors arrange a photograph; alternative b concerns office space after a promotion.
seedUse: Retains prize congratulations with resentment; replaces generic judge insult with copied applause and winner photograph.
